prefix_note: Templates use https://schema.org/ and SPARQL 1.1 only (Oxigraph + QLever).

queries.title: Probe sample triples
queries.description: Return a small sample of subject-predicate-object triples from default and named graphs. Use to verify the endpoint has data.

queries.title: List RDF types with counts
queries.description: Distinct rdf:type values and how many subjects use each type (named graphs).

queries.title: List named graphs
queries.description: Named graphs and approximate triple counts.

queries.title: Sample schema:Dataset records
queries.description: Sample Dataset resources with name, url, and description.

queries.title: Find datasets by name fragment
queries.description: Case-insensitive CONTAINS filter on schema:name. Requires --name.

queries.title: variableMeasured inventory
queries.description: List schema:PropertyValue nodes linked via variableMeasured (name, min/max, propertyID, units).

queries.title: Depth variable assay
queries.description: Aggregate variableMeasured names containing 'depth' with optional provider slug from graph IRI.

queries.title: DepBelowSurf min/max
queries.description: Min/max ranges for variableMeasured name DepBelowSurf (OIH depth profile).

queries.title: Count spatial coverage
queries.description: Count subjects with GeoSPARQL hasGeometry or schema:spatialCoverage.

queries.title: Providers from graph IRIs
queries.description: Distinct provider slugs parsed from Gleaner-style urn:gleaner.io graph IRIs. Empty if graph IRIs use another scheme.
